# Apple App Store API — ReplyNodes

Read-only Apple App Store data for AI agents. Search iOS apps and retrieve App Store metadata, iOS
app ratings, App Store reviews, developer/publisher catalogs, privacy labels, similar apps and
competitors as structured JSON. Use it for App Store search, ASO research, iOS app review analysis,
ratings lookup, developer lookup, app competitor research and mobile app competitive analysis.

Base URL: https://api.replynodes.com
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer $REPLYNODES_API_KEY`, sent only to https://api.replynodes.com — the
claim/poll protocol is embedded in `SKILL.md` (§Authentication).
Discovery (no key): https://api.replynodes.com/v1/capabilities

## Resolve first

Users name apps, the API takes identifiers. Search, then use `data[].id` (`ios:app:<digits>`, strip the
prefix for the numeric App Store ID) or `data[].bundle_id`. Never ask for a track ID when search can
resolve it.

## Intent → operation

| Intent | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Find an app by name / keyword | `GET /v1/appstore/search?term=<query>&num=20` |
| App metadata | `GET /v1/appstore/app?id=<id>` or `?appId=<bundleId>` |
| Ratings + star histogram | `GET /v1/appstore/ratings?id=<id>` |
| Reviews (analysis) | `GET /v1/appstore/reviews?id=<id>&page=1&sort=mostRecent` |
| Developer / publisher | `GET /v1/appstore/developer?devId=<numeric id>` |
| Privacy labels | `GET /v1/appstore/privacy?id=<id>` (degraded — see limitations) |
| Similar apps / competitors | `GET /v1/appstore/similar?id=<id>` |
| Keyword ideas (ASO) | `GET /v1/appstore/suggest?term=<seed>` |
| Storefront collections | `GET /v1/appstore/list?collection=topfreeapplications&category=6017&country=us` (empty in testing) |

## Limits that matter

- Read-only public data: no writes, purchases, accounts, App Store Connect or review submission.
- `reviews` page 1–10, `sort` `mostRecent`|`mostHelpful`, `search` `num` 1–50, `list` `num` 1–200.
- `devId` must be numeric; path-style routes (`/v1/appstore/apps/{id}`) are not deployed (404).
- Repeated identical requests return a replay envelope instead of the payload — vary an optional param.
- `privacy` returned `502` and `list` returned `[]` in the 2026-09-12 live audit; report failures.
- Missing counters are `null`, never `0`. No ranking/download/search-volume estimates.

Full detail: `SKILL.md`, `references/endpoints.md`, `references/live-audit.md`.
